name: Feasibility: Communication and support
description:
The portal should replace the partner Facebook group — explicitly not the Poradna.

h2. Scope in PRD

- Channel for a partner to report a current issue or open a discussion topic
- AI chatbot able to answer basic questions and navigate partners around the portal
- Terms and conditions
- Educational documentation / webinars
- Sign-up for beta testing

h2. To analyse

- Discussion/community functionality — build vs. integrate an existing tool
- Issue reporting — route into an existing ticketing system or build in-portal
- AI chatbot — knowledge source (docs, API docs), tooling, hosting, content freshness
- Where educational content is authored and stored
- Relation to the metric "reduction in time to resolve technical queries"

h2. Output

Systems involved, integration gaps, T-shirt size, blockers, MVP / later / out-of-scope recommendation.
